decisionBox.changed: THREE things changed, and unusually for this series they all point the same way. FIRST, the ETF print that the endday flagged as the single unresolved overnight catalyst landed POSITIVE: Farside's 04 Aug 2026 row filled in at +$211.5M (IBIT +170.3, FBTC +19.6, ARKB +9.2, BITB +8.7, MSBT +3.7), a second consecutive inflow day after 03 Aug's +$170.1M and the best print since 30 Jul. The endday explicitly wrote that a negative surprise was live and would hit a market that had just spent its short-side fuel; the opposite happened. SECOND, the technical stack has gone from good to clean. Price at 64,688.3 is above ALL FOUR 15m EMAs (64,300.98 / 64,240.97 / 64,149.46 / 63,952.69), ALL FOUR 1h EMAs (64,199.10 / 63,960.04 / 63,783.32 / 63,832.79), the 4h EMA200 at 64,077.56, the daily EMA20 at 63,984.15 — and it is now 24.3 points through the daily EMA50 at 64,664.04, which is the first time price has touched that line in this entire drawdown. The 4H MACD histogram has widened again to +97.15 with the line at +174.17. THIRD, and this is the reason confidence goes to 6.5 rather than higher, the liquidity map has REBUILT above the market. The endday recorded a literal ZERO at 64,407.79 after the squeeze consumed the whole upside band; tonight's CoinGlass column reads 1.01M at 64,884.48, only 196 points and 0.30% above spot. That is the nearest object in the near field in either direction and it is a magnet pulling up. Against that, the heavier aggregate still sits below — 1.00M at 63,652.56 plus 728.58K at 63,378.8 — and the OKX realized feed shows $4.00M of short liquidations against $991.6K of long in the last 24 hours, so a good deal of the short-side fuel has already been burned once. The stance is therefore a REAL ADD in spot, deliberately sized small, with no futures leg.

That asymmetry in distance is the whole argument for adding rather than trimming here.

calibration.rollingRecord: The endday report called bullish with a REDUCE stance, a 63,760 reduce trigger and a 63,400 add trigger. NEITHER fired: the session low of 63,893.0 stayed 133 points clear of the reduce level and 493 points clear of the add. Price then rose 618.8 points (+0.97%) to 64,688.3. So the DIRECTIONAL read was right and the ACTION was mildly wrong — the 10% spot trim booked at 64,069.5 gave up about 0.97% of participation on a tenth of the book, roughly 0.17 USDT of foregone gain. That is a small, defensible cost for overnight insurance and the report was explicit that it was insurance rather than a change of view, but honesty requires marking it as acting_helped = false. The endday's structural claim that the daily EMA20 close was 'the reclaim' has been vindicated: price has since held above it on every 1h bar and traded through the daily EMA50.
calibration.note: The endday's central worry has been resolved against it in the most useful way. It wrote that the unresolved 04 Aug ETF print was the live risk inside the gap and that 'a negative surprise is live'; the print landed at +$211.5M, the second consecutive inflow day. It also wrote that the liquidity asymmetry had inverted and that 'everything above spot to 64,835 is now thin'. That was true at the moment of writing and is no longer true: fourteen hours of rebuilt leverage have put 1.01M at 64,884.48, and price is 196 points beneath it. The lesson logged on 04 Aug — that heatmap cells are a snapshot of live leverage rather than a standing order book — cuts both ways, and this is the constructive direction. Standing weakness in the record: the midday session remains the worst-performing slot at -6.02 USDT attributed, against endday's +34.44.
